visual.description: GRIND quadrant (top-right) brightens. 5 dots appear: USA (largest), AUS, CAN, NZL, IRL. Flag strip shows all five — text badges. Text overlay: 'The Anglosphere Quadrant' — all English-speaking. Counter: '5 of 34.' Then USA-Denmark connector line draws across matrix. Side panel: USA ($45.82/hr, 1,810 hrs) vs Denmark ($53.99/hr, 1,371 hrs). Calendar grid: 55 days highlighted in red. Labels: '55 extra workdays ≈ 11 extra work weeks. For 12% more salary.'

textOverlay.anglosphereLabel: The Anglosphere Quadrant — all 5 countries English-speaking

notes: GRIND reveal + USA vs Denmark comparison. KEY CHANGE from v3: now 5 countries (not 2), all Anglosphere. The emptiness of GRIND is LESS dramatic with 5 dots but the Anglosphere pattern is a stronger insight. USA-DNK connector shows 439 hours = 55 days = 12% more salary (not 6% — old Big Mac metric). Calendar grid is the emotional peak. GRIND dot color: #D8A7B1.
